items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I saw Roosevelt, when he was nominated. First time in Chicago, Chicago Stadium, man.

ctx.x: Harry Hopkins, I don't remember him.
Well, he's at the WP, the WP National, all over the countries. I see. He and Roosevelt like that.
Oh, yeah, you mean Harry Hopkins from Washington.
